cookies.title: Cookie Preferences
cookies.intro: We use cookies to enhance your experience. Essential cookies (location and storefront) are required for the site to work.
cookies.essentialDescription: Required for the website to function. Includes location detection (market/country) and storefront selection.
cookies.analyticsDescription: Help us understand how visitors interact with our website. Includes Google Analytics.
cookies.functionalDescription: Enable enhanced functionality like language preferences and cart persistence.

about.title: About Us
about.p1: Lunera is a lingerie boutique based in Kosovo. We curate thoughtful pieces designed for everyday comfort and quiet confidence — soft fabrics, clean lines, and styles that feel as good as they look.
about.p2: Our focus is on quality you can wear daily: lingerie and essentials chosen with care for fit, feel, and lasting wear. Whether you are building a capsule wardrobe or finding something special, we want shopping with us to feel simple and personal.
about.p3: We ship from Kosovo and are building Lunera for customers who value comfort, honesty, and a calm shopping experience. Thank you for being here — we are glad you found us.
about.instagramCta: Stay up to date on our newest products and exclusive offers. Follow us on Instagram to be the first to know about new arrivals, styling tips, and special promotions.
about.followInstagram: Follow us on Instagram to see the latest catalog

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Text: This privacy policy describes how Lunera ("we", "us") collects and uses personal information when you visit our website or place an order. We operate an online storefront for lingerie and related products, currently serving customers with a focus on Kosovo.
privacy.s2Text: We may collect information you provide directly (such as name, email, shipping address, and order details), technical data needed to run the site (such as cookies for market/storefront and language preferences), and payment-related information processed by our payment providers. We do not store full payment card numbers on our servers.
privacy.s3Text: We use your information to process and deliver orders, provide customer support, improve our website and shopping experience, comply with legal obligations, and — only where you have consented — for analytics or marketing communications.
privacy.s4Text: We use essential cookies so the site can detect your market and storefront. With your consent, we may also use functional cookies (for example language preference and cart) and analytics cookies. You can manage non-essential cookies through our cookie banner.
privacy.s5Text: We share personal data only when needed to fulfill your order or run the business — for example with shipping partners, payment processors, and hosting/infrastructure providers. We do not sell your personal information.
privacy.s6Text: We keep order and account-related information for as long as needed to fulfill orders, handle returns, meet accounting and legal requirements, and resolve disputes. You may contact us to ask about deletion where applicable by law.
privacy.s7Text: Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, or restrict processing of your personal data, and to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent. Contact us to exercise these rights.
privacy.s8Text: If you have questions about this privacy policy or how we handle your data, please contact us.
